name: ic-stm32-decoder
description: Zero-dependency IC date code & lot marking decoder (YWW, YYWW, WWYY, YYMM, YYDDD Julian, onsemi AND8002/D 12-year two-letter, National Semiconductor SNOA039C 6-week) and datasheet-backed STM32 ordering part number decoder.

scripts.test:all: node --test tests/node.test.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
